MORE WAYS TO KEEP A STORY

From art to objects.

Poster artwork is exportable today. Figurines, playable chessboards and other custom objects are future product formats; they need a manufacturing partner and a supported catalog. CraftKit’s design templates preserve the gameplay source so new outputs can grow from the same story.

Examples use recorded sample gameplay. Photographs are illustrative mockups. Actual products, materials and prices come from Arcade before purchase.
